successCriteria.description: PgEmployeeRepository class exists at src/modules/employee/employee.repository.ts and satisfies the IEmployeeRepository interface from ./employee.model.ts (all six methods present with matching signatures)

PgEmployeeRepository uses the pg Pool exported from src/shared/db/connection.ts (imports `pool` and calls pool.query) — no inline pg.Pool construction, no direct pg.Client, no other connection mechanism
All six PgEmployeeRepository methods use parameterized queries ($1, $2, …) — no string concatenation or template-literal interpolation of values into SQL
PgEmployeeRepository.softDelete(id) sets deleted_at = NOW() (or equivalent current timestamp) on the matching row and returns Promise<void> — does not physically delete the row
PgEmployeeRepository.findAll() returns only rows where deleted_at IS NULL (soft-deleted employees are excluded)

PgLeavePolicyRepository class exists at src/modules/leave-policy/leave-policy.repository.ts and satisfies the ILeavePolicyRepository interface from ./leave-policy.model.ts (all five methods present with matching signatures)
PgLeavePolicyRepository uses the pg Pool exported from src/shared/db/connection.ts — no inline pool construction or alternative connection
All five PgLeavePolicyRepository methods use parameterized queries — no string concatenation or template-literal interpolation of values into SQL
PgLeavePolicyRepository.findAllActive() returns only rows where is_active = true

constraints: Both repository classes MUST import the pg Pool from src/shared/db/connection.ts (import { pool } from '../../shared/db/connection' or equivalent relative path) — no other database connection mechanism is permitted (HARNESS.json constraint: no-direct-db-outside-repository, GP-001)
All SQL queries MUST use parameterized placeholders ($1, $2, …) — never concatenate or interpolate values into query strings (prevents SQL injection)
Repository methods MUST NOT use `any` type — use `unknown` with type guards where needed (HARNESS.json constraint: no-any)
Repository implementations MUST NOT import or depend on any service, controller, or route module — they depend only on their own model file and the shared db connection
outOfScope: Sub-phase 2/3: LeavePolicy Service — src/modules/leave-policy/leave-policy.service.ts (produced by a sibling sub-phase)

ambiguities.description: Column-name mapping convention: the Employee/LeavePolicy entity interfaces use camelCase (e.g., employeeNumber, firstName, leaveType, policyName) while the DB tables use snake_case (employee_number, first_name, leave_type, policy_name). Should the repository perform this mapping inline in each method, or extract a shared mapper?
options: Inline mapping in each method (simpler, no extra file)
Extract a private toRow/fromRow mapper per repository class

entityInvariants.invariant: An Employee row is never physically deleted — softDelete sets deleted_at to the current timestamp; findAll and findById must exclude rows where deleted_at IS NOT NULL
A LeavePolicy's isActive flag controls visibility in findAllActive — only policies with isActive = true are returned; inactive policies remain in the database but are excluded from active queries

PgLeavePolicyRepository MUST implement the exact ILeavePolicyRepository interface declared in src/modules/leave-policy/leave-policy.model.ts — method names, parameter types, and return types must match exactly (findById, findByLeaveType, findAllActive, create, update)
